# Entra.EventHandlers
 
> Entra.EventHandlers is a strongly typed .NET ecosystem for building Microsoft Entra External ID custom authentication extension event handlers.
 
Entra.EventHandlers provides strongly typed event models, fluent response builders,
event handler infrastructure, dependency injection integration, and hosting integrations
for ASP.NET Core and Azure Functions.
 
Use the documentation and samples below when implementing Microsoft Entra External ID
custom authentication extensions with Entra.EventHandlers.
 
## Documentation
 
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md: Start here. Install Entra.EventHandlers, implement an event handler, register dependency injection, choose a hosting model, and find complete samples.
 
## Source
 
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers: Main Entra.EventHandlers repository containing the core libraries, hosting integrations, samples, tests, and documentation.
 
## Samples
 
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers/tree/main/samples/Sample.Common: Shared event handler implementations demonstrating fluent response builders, custom claims, prefill values, block responses, and handler business logic.
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers/tree/main/samples/ApiSample: Complete ASP.NET Core sample using Entra.EventHandlers.
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers/tree/main/samples/AzureFunctionsSample: Complete Azure Functions sample using Entra.EventHandlers.AzureFunctions.
- https://github.com/szubajak/entra-event-handlers-azurefunctions: Minimal standalone Azure Functions Isolated Worker sample demonstrating a single EmailOtpSend handler and function, dependency injection, exception handling, and unit testing.
